title: Hot Indian Fish Bowl
description: A quick, peppery fish bowl served with a fresh cucumber lassi, perfect for a light lunch.
instructions: Place garlic and ginger in a mortar and pound with a pestle until a fine paste forms.
Stir in garam masala, red chili flakes, and salt to create a spice rub.
Marinate the tilapia fillets in the paste, lemon juice, and a splash of olive oil for 5 minutes.
Heat a skillet over medium heat and sear the fillets for 3 minutes on each side until cooked through.
Transfer the fish to a tagliere and set aside.
Whisk yogurt with a pinch of salt to make a quick cucumber lassi; refrigerate until ready.
Dice cucumber and bell pepper, then sprinkle over the fish on the tagliere.
Drizzle remaining olive oil and chopped coriander over the bowl.
Serve the fish bowl with the chilled cucumber lassi on the side.
Enjoy a fresh, peppery meal in under 30 minutes.
